earned_normal_mechanics.comparison: All four ended in one hit with unchanged earned gear in the draft profile. Earlier gear and Kachina were equipped in town to exercise the mechanics.

skill_runtime_checks.scope: Prepared combat checks cooldowns, static damage profiles, and companion action locks and scheduled timings. Special followups and actual hits have separate tests. Chrome covers a regional acquisition, loadout restoration, a dodge interrupt, and the shared water field.

coop_lunar_star_checks.scope: Shared enemy tests cover lunar aura owner identity, the room clock, application cooldowns, ordinary cross-party burning, separate rewards, and one star seed burst. Chrome covers the companion gates and the peer effects.

party_checkpoint_checks.scope: A field checkpoint resumes at the existing hub while restoring party HP, remaining cooldowns, reserve state, and active selection. Compatible with v1 files without the optional party state.

party_presets.scope: Town-only registration and atomic switching of companion, weapons, two five-piece artifact loadouts by item ID, and eight skill or macro slots. Compatible with v1 saves without presets.

weapon_progression.scope: Fixed weapon classes, quest rewards, exclusive equipment references, combat ATK, upgrades, presets and saves. Browser exercises the Liyue market delivery reward. Runtime balance and acquisition paths remain provisional.

field_balance_draft.scope: Optional local server applies level-based ordinary field HP, revised reward sword ATK, and fixed trial HP for ten normal bosses, selected weekly tiers, and Beidou extreme. The draft server is unranked and uses the existing EXP and Mora formulas.

snezhnaya_normal_boss_hp.checkpoint_conversion: Preserves remaining HP percentage, elapsed time, respawn cooldown, and phase flags when changing profiles.

natlan_gear_recovery.scope: Fill vacant Traveler flower and feather slots from spare artifacts at the Natlan hub or open a route to Ridge Watch via Mondstadt. Compared three Lua hunting and equipment routes from an earned Lv100 save to Nod-Krai at Lv120 under the optional draft balance.

nod_vault_reward_comparison.scope: View both cache rewards and the Traveler's equipped flower and feather main stats before selecting. Verified inventory capacity, both reward choices, one-time reward, and mobile display.

white_pass_draft_route.scope: Continues the draft Lv140 save earned at Nod-Krai, reports eight quests, equips the fixed sword reward, and unlocks Aurora at Lv160. Browser verification covers the train, equipment and progress restore, light release, and the next gate.

level_cap_draft_route.scope: Continues the earned draft Lv160 checkpoint through all nine final field gates, five growth reports, three challenge reports, post-cap EXP and save restoration. This proves the documented route and challenges under the draft profile.

full_atlas_checkpoint_transfer.scope: Prepared Lv200 checkpoint with all atlas nodes and hidden discoveries, 80 bag items, 160 uncollected drops, and three party presets.

quest_runtime_checks.scope: Per-quest acceptance, report and post-report save restoration evidence for every currently offered story quest. Scenario fixtures may prepare levels, locations or earlier progress.

multiplayer_preview.active_map_scope: Configured co-op locations outside suspended story regions. Historic verification below includes earlier maps.

stygian_mode_launches.scope: Local HTTP room entry, shared boss HP and battle launch. Defeat and reward checks remain separate.

farka_higher_mode_clears.scope: Directional and normal-attack inputs in the Lua room from the reported Lv200 save; each player collected or was excluded from first-clear rewards as appropriate, then restored their checkpoint through local HTTP.

beidou_higher_mode_clears.scope: Lua inputs through guard, baited reply, returning wave and recovery; local HTTP checked rewards, inventory and restored saves for all four parties.

capitano_higher_mode_clears.scope: Lua movement and attacks in recovery through three stages and all four CP09 windows; local HTTP verified payout, inventory and restore.

xbalanque_higher_mode_clears.scope: Lua movement and attacks in recovery through three stages and all four XB08 windows; local HTTP verified payout, inventory and restore.

wanderer_higher_mode_clears.scope: Lua movement, jump and normal attacks through updrafts, the forced landing and the widened personal finale gate; local HTTP verified payout, inventory and restore.

rerir_higher_mode_clears.scope: Lua inputs through both fog lamps and both trials; separate parties collected three marks and qualified for protection on each path. Local HTTP verified payout, inventory and restore.

ronova_higher_mode_clears.scope: Lua inputs through four stages, one authority defeat and partner aid, all four road markers, and a personal finale gate. Local HTTP verified payout, inventory and restore.

stygian_four_party_clear_coverage.scope: Local Lua room combat driven by scripted movement, jumps, attacks and mechanics; local HTTP verified payout and saves. Higher-mode records are linked individually.

boss_commission_links.scope: Atlas links standalone commissions and itinerary boss steps to their current status and hub.
